title: A $1 Billion UAE Initiative for AI in Africa! 🌍
body: A $1 Billion UAE Initiative for AI in Africa! 🌍
The 'AI for Development' forum opened in Abu Dhabi to discuss a UAE initiative worth $1 billion to support AI projects in developing countries, with a focus on Africa.
The initiative targets 6 sectors: education, agriculture, energy, environment, healthcare and digital infrastructure.
Can AI change people's lives in Africa? 💡
